name: 0000-MAIN
description: This paragraph initializes necessary resources, performs a fetch operation on customer data, and then cleans up and terminates the program.

algorithm.details: Open file or necessary resource for processing
Call the 1000-FETCH-CUSTOMERS paragraph to retrieve customer data
Ensure any opened resources are properly closed
Return control to the operating system with a GOBACK

sideEffects.description: May initialize or prepare an output report file during the open/close operations
